output.level_0: The feature store crashes nightly, leaving the forecast job without any point of sale history to read.
output.level_1: There is no central feature store, so every model trains on raw till scans pulled from different sources.
output.level_2: Data engineers manually export point of sale and stock tables into a shared folder before every training run.
output.level_3: A feature store automatically computes and serves point of sale, stock, and promotion features to the training pipeline.
output.level_4: The feature store enforces access controls and lineage for loyalty data, ensuring only approved features reach the model.
